query_text: Need a mobile app that predicts how much my blood sugar will spike based on what I just ate, because I'm tired of guessing and feeling sluggish after meals. I pick a meal or type in the foods, and it gives me a quick spike estimate so I know whether to walk around a bit or just take it easy. Something simple for my phone, one meal at a time, no complicated setup.

Build a carb counting tool for my phone that makes managing a diabetic diet way less painful, because right now I have to look everything up separately and do the math myself. I want to tap a food, get the carb count right away, and track my running total for the day so I can see where I stand. Keep it simple and fast, just the bare numbers I actually need.

Build a mobile app that lays out keto, paleo, and Mediterranean diets side by side so I can actually figure out which one fits my life, because I keep reading about all three and getting confused about what I can and cannot eat on each. Let me pick a food and see how it fits across all three plans at a glance, and maybe a quick summary of the main rules for each diet so I can compare them without reading a bunch of articles.

Create a calculator for my phone that tells me how many calories and how much sugar is in whatever drink I pick, like beer, wine, cocktails, or hard seltzer, because I never think about how much this stuff adds up. I pick the type of drink and the size, and it shows me the calorie and sugar count right away so I can make a smarter choice without having to do any math.

Need a mobile app that ranks common foods by fiber content so I can stop guessing what to eat when my gut feels off, because I always hear that fiber is good for digestion but I have no idea which foods actually have a lot of it. I want to browse a list sorted by fiber amount, maybe filter by type like vegetables, grains, or fruit, and tap any item to see a quick breakdown of why it helps with gut health.

Need a mobile app that scores foods on how anti-inflammatory they are, because I keep seeing stuff about inflammation but I have zero idea which things I eat are helping versus making it worse. I just want to search or tap a food on my phone and get a straightforward score telling me whether it helps calm inflammation or not, with a short reason why so I actually understand it.

Need a recipe guide app for my phone focused on beginners who can only use five ingredients per dish, with a clear list of what to buy, step-by-step instructions that assume you know nothing about cooking, and a way to mark recipes as done once you have tried them. I want to be able to filter by meal type like breakfast, lunch, or dinner, and each recipe should show exactly which five ingredients are needed right at the top.

A world street food recipe explorer app for my phone where I can browse dishes organized by country or region, see the full ingredient list and steps for each one, and save the ones I want to try to a personal list. Each recipe should show the country it comes from and a short note about what makes it special, and I want to be able to tap through from region to dish to full recipe without losing my place.

Need a mobile app for digitising and archiving family recipes, where I can type in grandma's recipes one by one, add the name of who it came from, and organise them into categories like soups, mains, and desserts. Each saved recipe should show the ingredients and steps clearly, and I want a search bar so I can find any recipe fast without scrolling through everything.

Create a kid-friendly cooking activity app for my phone with simple recipes that children can help make, showing each step with big clear text and noting which parts a kid can do versus which parts need adult help. I want recipes sorted by age range, a short list of needed ingredients at the top of each one, and a fun way to mark each step as finished as you go through the recipe together.

Create a budget recipe app for my phone that only shows meals costing five dollars or less per serving, with the total estimated cost shown right at the top of each recipe before I even tap in. I want to be able to filter by meal type, see a simple ingredient list with rough prices, and save my favourite cheap meals to a personal list so I can come back to them on shopping day.

A recipe converter app for my phone that takes a standard recipe and adapts the cooking time and method for either a slow cooker or an instant pot, because I can never figure out how to adjust things myself without ruining the dish. I pick which appliance I'm using, paste or enter the original recipe, and the app spits out the adjusted time and any steps that need to change, all on one easy-to-read screen.

Need a mobile app that helps me plan party appetizers and finger foods, where I can pick a theme or number of guests and it gives me a tidy list of bite-size dishes that work well together. I want each item to show a short ingredients list and simple prep steps, and a checkbox so I can tick things off as I prepare them the day before my party.

Need a mobile app that suggests the right dessert to pair with whatever main course I'm making, because I always end up just guessing and sometimes the combination feels off. I type in my main dish, and it gives me a few dessert ideas that go well with it, with a short reason why each one works and a basic recipe summary so I can decide quickly and start shopping.

A saved favourites tracker app for my phone where I can keep all the restaurants I love in one beautiful place, browsing them like a little curated collection with photos and a short personal note for each one. The whole thing should feel warm and personal, like a private little food diary, and I want a gentle reminder to revisit places I haven't been to in a while so my favourites list actually stays alive.

A friend recommendation app for my phone where all the restaurant tips from people I trust live together in one spot, organised in a way that feels like flipping through a stylish little zine rather than a generic list. Each entry shows who recommended it, what they said about it, and whether I have been yet, and the whole vibe should feel personal and warm, like advice from a close friend rather than a faceless review site.

A neighbourhood new openings discovery app for my phone that surfaces recently opened places nearby in a visually inviting way, almost like a little editorial guide you would find in a local lifestyle magazine. Each new spot gets a short intro with the vibe and what kind of food it serves, and I want to be able to follow places I am curious about so I hear when they start getting buzz from real visitors.

Need a mobile app that lets me rate and review individual dishes at a restaurant rather than the whole place, because often one dish is amazing and another is forgettable and lumping it all together feels wrong. I tap the restaurant, find the specific dish, give it a rating, and leave a short note about what made it special or disappointing, so my review actually means something useful the next time I visit.

Need a mobile restaurant finder app that lets me filter by the feeling and occasion I'm going for, like choosing between a candlelit romantic dinner, a laid-back casual bite, a lively group celebration, or a quiet solo lunch, because searching by cuisine type alone never quite captures the vibe I'm after. I pick the occasion that matches my mood and it shows me places that genuinely fit that feeling, with a photo and a line or two that captures the atmosphere.

Make a chef profile app for my phone that feels like an intimate behind-the-scenes look at the people running the kitchens I love, where each chef gets a dedicated space with their story, what drives their cooking, and the dishes they are most proud of. The whole thing should read like a beautifully made mini-documentary, with a warm editorial feel rather than a bland bio page, so I actually feel connected to the food before I even sit down.

Build a loyalty stamp tracker app for my phone where all my coffee shop and restaurant reward cards live in one place, displayed in a way that feels satisfying and a little delightful, like watching a collection come together. Each card shows the stamps I have collected so far, how close I am to a reward, and what the reward actually is, so I always know when I am one visit away from something worth celebrating.

Create a seasonal menu alert app for my phone that lets me follow my favourite restaurants and notifies me in a beautiful, editorial way whenever they refresh their menu for a new season, because I always miss the limited dishes I actually care about. Each alert should feel considered and curated, with a short note about what is new and why it is worth visiting now, rather than just a plain notification that I would swipe away.

Need a movie quote completion challenge game on my phone where it shows you the first part of a famous line and you have to type or pick how it ends, kind of like a fun trivia thing I can play on the bus. I want it to pull from all different genres and eras, show a little score after each round, and let me share my results so I can challenge my friends to beat me.

Need a historical year guessing game for my phone where it describes a real event and you have to guess what year it happened, because I love history trivia but most quiz apps mix everything together and the history rounds go by too fast. I want a dedicated game where each round gives a clue about a famous moment, I type or slide to guess the year, and it tells me how close I was with a quick fun fact about the event after I answer.

Need a fun game on my phone where it shows you a sequence of emojis and you have to figure out what story, movie, song, or phrase they represent, because I tried this as a party game once and everyone loved it but there was no actual app for it. I want a game with different rounds or categories, a text box to type my answer, and a way to see the correct answer with a little explanation if I get it wrong.
